title: The Lantern of Valparaíso
author: Rafael Whitlock
blurb: Edmund Pemberton, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
